title: Highway Segmentation Analysis Run Spec
description: Schema for a headless (CLI) analysis run specification. This file is intended to be generated by the GUI and consumed by the CLI runner.

$schema.description: Optional URI of the schema used to validate this run spec

input.description: Input data specification. Exactly one of 'data_file_path' or 'data_source' must be provided.

data_file_path.description: Path to the input CSV/XLSX file. Mutually exclusive with 'data_source'.

data_source.description: Database connection parameters. Mutually exclusive with 'data_file_path'. Set the HST_DB_PASSWORD environment variable to supply the password — never put it in the spec file.

host.description: Database server hostname or IP address

table_or_view.description: Name of the table or view to query

username.description: Database username. Password must be set via the HST_DB_PASSWORD environment variable.

connection_name.description: Optional human-readable label for this connection (used for system-keyring lookup when running interactively)

x_column.description: Column name used as the X-axis (distance/position)

y_column.description: Column name used as the Y-axis (measurement value)

gap_threshold.description: Gap threshold (units of the X-axis). Must be > 0

route_column.description: Optional route ID column name. If null/omitted, treat the dataset as a single route

selected_routes.description: Optional explicit list of routes to process. If null/omitted, process all routes. When direction_column or lane_column are configured, route IDs are composite strings (e.g. 'Route1|NB|K1') — list those composite keys here to filter.

direction_column.description: Optional column containing roadbed/direction identifier (e.g. NB, SB, K1, K6). Concatenated with route_column and lane_column to form a composite route key.

lane_column.description: Optional column containing lane identifier. Concatenated with route_column and direction_column to form a composite route key.

x_min.description: Optional minimum x-value (milepoint). Rows where the x-column value is less than x_min are excluded before analysis.

x_max.description: Optional maximum x-value (milepoint). Rows where the x-column value is greater than x_max are excluded before analysis.

must_break_columns.description: Optional list of primary attribute columns that force a mandatory breakpoint when their value changes. Applied after gap analysis and before primary preprocessing. If null/omitted, no primary attribute must-breaks are applied.

secondary_break_columns.description: Optional list of secondary attribute columns that force a mandatory breakpoint when their value changes. Applied after primary preprocessing and before secondary preprocessing, and tracked separately for reporting. If null/omitted, no secondary attribute must-breaks are applied.

method_key.description: Optimization/analysis method key (must correspond to a configured method_key in src/config.py)

method_parameters.description: Method-scoped parameters passed to the selected analysis method. This is intentionally flexible to support new methods without changing the schema.

preprocessing.description: Optional preprocessing configuration for data cleaning and outlier handling before analysis

enabled.description: Master switch to enable/disable all preprocessing. When false, all preprocessing phases are skipped.

pre_gap_method.description: Optional preprocessing method to apply before gap analysis. Method key must exist in PREPROCESSING_METHODS registry.

pre_gap_parameters.description: Parameters for the pre-gap preprocessing method. Schema is method-specific.

primary_method.description: Optional primary preprocessing method to apply after gap analysis and primary attribute breaks. This is the most commonly used preprocessing phase.

primary_parameters.description: Parameters for the primary preprocessing method. Schema is method-specific.

secondary_method.description: Optional secondary preprocessing method to apply after secondary attribute breaks. Used for multi-stage preprocessing workflows.

secondary_parameters.description: Parameters for the secondary preprocessing method. Schema is method-specific.

output_json_path.description: Path to write the schema-compliant JSON results

overwrite.description: If true, allow overwriting an existing output file
